observation.command: cd /workspace && grep -E '^\s{0,4}[a-z_0-9-]+:\s*$|image:|container_name:|ports:|publish:|target:' docker-compose.yml | head -40 && echo '--- build overlay ---' && cat docker-compose.build.yml
